to Zoom Revenue Accelerator and making Common Room available through its own channel.

These additions point at different parts of the sales process. Engage builds multichannel outreach sequences across email and phone, prioritizes follow-up and uses automated triggers to reach prospects at scale. Forecast turns deal-level signals into a live forecast, letting leaders drill from company commitments down to individual opportunities, with revenue operations teams able to configure views and write updates back to the CRM without engineering support.

Zoom argues the calls happening on its platform contain what a buyer cares about, the objections raised, who is involved in a decision and what was agreed, and that connecting that to prospecting and forecasting creates a continuous loop. Barracuda Networks, a Zoom customer, reported a 15% increase in deals closed and 5% faster deal velocity using Revenue Accelerator. The product now sells in three tiers, with the new Elite level including both Engage and Forecast.

title: Zoom Moves Into Sales Software With Engage and Forecast
